name: cr733_1_a_cancelled_cast_puts_the_card_back_on_top
why: CR 733.1: a cast reversed returns the card to its library's top slot; nothing moved a card from a library to anywhere but the stack, and what was revealed stays seen: B saw it go and come back, so B knows the card on top. CR 401.5: A never saw the card under it. The cast is offered again.
expect_dump: ^B .*event CAST_FROM_HIDDEN LIBRARY>STACK card=Chalice of the Void
^B .*event ZONE_MOVE STACK>LIBRARY card=Chalice of the Void
expect_dump_final: ^A .*reveal STANDING_LOOK LIBRARY pos=0 card=Chalice of the Void
^A .*position self top0 = Chalice of the Void
^B .*position opp top0 = Chalice of the Void
